deploy-bot: PROD deploy starting — env=prod-us-east-1, tag=rel/v3.8.0-rc5, commit=9f7d3c4. Plan: dry-run -> canary (5% -> 20%) -> gradual to 100% in steps. Dry-run passed. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-deploy-v3.8.0-rc5. Kicking off now.

maria-ops: ack. I'll watch SLOs, traces, and cost dashboards. Holding window 08:00-10:00 PT noted.

sam-eng: saw a tiny p95 bump on canary at 5% for seq=1024 (+40ms). Noticed a tail on one node, digging in.

infra-bot: build verification ok, images pushed, infra health checks ✅.

jessica-releases: recommendation: hold at 20% for 10m to validate seqlen regressions. If p95 > +100ms or errors >0.2% we rollback. Rollback command in runbook: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference --to-revision=prev`

deploy-bot: rolled to 5% canary -> smoke ok -> advancing to 20% and entering hold (10m). Pinning release tag rel/v3.8.0-rc5.

sam-eng: running evals against canary set (long prompts + few-shot). Posting quick logs if anything pops.

infra-bot: metrics update: after 8m p95 trending back to baseline, error rate 0.03%, CPU on serving nodes stable.

deploy-bot: hold passed — proceeding with gradual traffic increase. Stepping 20% -> 50% -> 100% over ~12m.

deploy-bot: rollout complete. Final state: success. Completed at 4781234627. Tag=rel/v3.8.0-rc5 commit=9f7d3c4. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.8.0-rc5. No automatic rollbacks triggered. :tada:

maria-ops: thanks all — monitoring for the next hour and will escalate on any regression. :thumbsup:

jessica-releases: posting a short summary to #announcements and updating the changelog now.
